self_reflection_notes: I adjusted the qa_score for atom 1 ('Is the kangaroo blue?') from 0.2 to 0.3. Since there is distinct, intentional blue coloration on the ears and tail (visible in the image), a score of 0.2 was too harsh and implied almost no adherence. A score of 0.3 better reflects that while the literal intrinsic color is wrong, the visual concept of 'blue' was attempted via lighting, distinguishing it from a complete failure. I also raised the alignment_score from 4.2 to 4.3 to reflect this slight calibration. All other scores remain consistent with the initial assessment as they were well-supported by expert evidence (detectors, classifiers) and visual verification.
